## Objective

```{=html}
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Noto+Sans+Bengali:wght@400;600&display=swap">
<style>
.reveal .logo-strip{align-items:center;}
.reveal .logo-strip img:nth-child(2){max-width:420px;max-height:50px;}
:root{
  --dark:#530153; --base:#800280; --light:#B974B9; --tint:#F4EAF4;
  --grey:#6B6B6B; --rule:#E2E2E2; --ink:#1A1A1A;
  --ok:#1E8F5B; --warn:#A6640C; --bad:#C0392B;
  --shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(83,1,83,.10);
}
.reveal .bn{font-family:"Noto Sans Bengali","Lato",sans-serif;font-size:1.08em;}
.reveal .lede{font-size:1.02em;color:var(--dark);font-weight:700;margin:0.1em 0 0.7em;line-height:1.35;}
.reveal .muted{color:var(--grey);}
.reveal .small{font-size:0.72em;}
.reveal .cap{font-size:0.5em;color:var(--grey);margin-top:0.7em;}
.reveal .mono{font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;}

/* ---------- shared visual vocabulary ---------- */
.v{font-size:0.8em;line-height:1.38;}
.v.lg{font-size:0.9em;}
.kick{display:block;font:700 0.72em Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--base);margin-bottom:0.35em;}
.ttl{display:block;font:700 1.08em Montserrat,sans-serif;color:var(--dark);margin-bottom:0.3em;line-height:1.25;}
.node{background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--base);border-radius:12px;padding:0.8em 0.95em;box-shadow:var(--shadow);}
.node.qa{background:var(--tint);border:1.5px solid var(--light);}
.node.plain{border:1.5px solid var(--rule);}
.node.hero{background:var(--dark);border-color:var(--dark);color:#fff;}
.node.hero .ttl{color:#fff;} .node.hero .kick{color:var(--light);}
.node.dash{border-style:dashed;border-color:var(--light);box-shadow:none;}
.node p{margin:0.25em 0;}
.g2{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0.8em;}
.g3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0.8em;}
.g4{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0.8em;}
.dot{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:2em;height:2em;border-radius:50%;
  border:2px solid var(--base);color:var(--base);background:#fff;font:700 0.85em Montserrat,sans-serif;flex:none;}
.dot.fill{background:var(--base);color:#fff;}
.banner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.8em;background:var(--dark);color:#fff;border-radius:10px;padding:0.6em 1em;margin-top:1em;}
.banner b{color:#fff;}
.banner.light{background:var(--tint);color:var(--ink);border-left:4px solid var(--base);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;}
.banner.light b{color:var(--dark);}
.icon{width:1.9em;height:1.9em;flex:none;}
.icon path,.icon rect,.icon circle,.icon polyline{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.ok{color:var(--ok);font-weight:700;} .bad{color:var(--bad);font-weight:700;}
.chip{display:inline-block;border-radius:999px;padding:0.12em 0.7em;font-size:0.85em;font-weight:700;border:1.5px solid var(--light);color:var(--dark);background:#fff;}
.arrowcol{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--light);font:700 1.6em Montserrat,sans-serif;}

/* field checklist */
.field .node{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;column-gap:0.7em;align-content:start;padding:0.7em 0.85em;}
.field .node .icon{grid-row:1 / span 2;width:1.6em;height:1.6em;}
.field .node .ttl{margin-bottom:0.15em;}
.term.sm pre code{font-size:0.7em!important;padding:0.5em 0.9em!important;}
.term.sm .tb{padding:0.25em 0.7em;}

/* objective tiles */
.obj .node{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.4em;}
.obj .head{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6em;}
.obj .head .ttl{margin:0;}

/* agenda rail */
.rail{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);margin-top:1.4em;}
.rail:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:10%;right:10%;top:1em;height:2px;background:var(--rule);}
.rail .st{position:relative;text-align:center;padding:0 0.5em;}
.rail .st .dot{width:2.3em;height:2.3em;font-size:0.9em;}
.rail .st .ttl{margin-top:0.7em;font-size:1.1em;}
.rail .st p{color:#3a3a3a;margin:0.3em 0 0.6em;}
.rail .st .min{font:700 0.8em Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--grey);}
.rail .st.qa .dot{background:var(--tint);}

/* setting */
.setting{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.55fr 1fr;gap:1em;align-items:stretch;}
.setting .ch{display:flex;gap:0.8em;align-items:flex-start;padding:0.65em 0.9em;margin-bottom:0.55em;}
.setting .ch .icon{color:var(--base);margin-top:0.1em;}
.setting .hero{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;}
.setting .big{font:700 2.6em Montserrat,sans-serif;line-height:1;color:#fff;}
.setting .hero ul{list-style:none;margin:0.7em 0 0;padding:0;}
.setting .hero li{margin:0.3em 0;font-size:1em;}
.setting .hero li:before{content:"✕ ";color:var(--light);font-weight:700;}

/* never invent */
.fails{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1em;margin:0.2em 0 0.9em;}
.fail{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:0.6em;}
.fail .side{text-align:center;}
.fail .num{display:block;font:700 2.5em Montserrat,sans-serif;line-height:1.05;color:var(--dark);}
.fail .num.x{color:var(--bad);text-decoration:line-through;text-decoration-thickness:3px;}
.fail .lab{font-size:0.85em;color:var(--grey);}
.rules3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:0.8em;}
.rules3 .node{border-width:0 0 0 4px;border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;box-shadow:none;background:var(--tint);border-color:var(--base);}

/* what does not work */
.nowork .node{border-top:4px solid var(--bad);border-left:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-right:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--rule);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.nowork .viz{height:5.4em;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0.2em 0 0.6em;background:#FBF8FB;border-radius:8px;}
.minibars{width:88%;}
.minibars .r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:6.8em 1fr 2.6em;align-items:center;gap:0.4em;margin:0.35em 0;font-size:0.9em;}
.minibars .b{height:0.85em;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;}
.numfix{font:700 1.45em/1.35 "SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;color:var(--dark);text-align:center;}
.numfix .x{color:var(--bad);}

/* witnesses */
.wit{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;gap:0.7em;align-items:stretch;}
.wit .plus{display:flex;align-items:center;font:700 2em Montserrat,sans-serif;color:var(--light);}
.wit .row{display:flex;gap:0.5em;margin:0.35em 0;}
.wit .row b.ok,.wit .row b.bad{flex:none;width:1em;}
.merge{display:flex;justify-content:center;margin:0.3em 0;}
.merge svg{width:60%;height:2em;}
.merge path{fill:none;stroke:var(--light);stroke-width:2;}

/* svg diagrams generic */
.reveal svg.dg{width:100%;height:auto;overflow:visible;font-family:"Lato",sans-serif;}
.dg .n{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:1.5;}
.dg .n.ai{stroke:var(--base);stroke-width:2;}
.dg .n.qa{fill:var(--tint);stroke:var(--light);}
.dg .hero{fill:var(--dark);}
.dg .pill{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--light);stroke-width:1.5;}
.dg .pill.win{fill:var(--tint);stroke:var(--base);stroke-width:2.5;}
.dg .ln{fill:none;stroke:var(--light);stroke-width:2;}
.dg .ln.d{stroke:var(--dark);}
.dg .ln.dash{stroke-dasharray:5 5;}
.dg .t{fill:var(--dark);font:700 16px Montserrat,sans-serif;}
.dg .s{fill:#3a3a3a;font-size:15px;}
.dg .s.g{fill:var(--grey);}
.dg .k{fill:var(--base);font:700 11px Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;}
.dg .inv{fill:#fff;} .dg .k.inv{fill:var(--light);}
.dg .x{fill:var(--grey);text-decoration:line-through;}
.dg .okc{fill:var(--ok);font-weight:700;}

/* judge example */
.reveal table.witness{font-size:0.8em!important;}
.witness{line-height:1.5;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0 5px;width:100%;}
.witness td{padding:0.55em 0.9em;vertical-align:middle;}
.witness td:first-child{padding-left:1.1em;}
.reveal .witness tr.j b,.reveal .witness tr.j strong{color:#fff!important;}
.witness td:first-child{width:24%;white-space:nowrap;}
.witness td:last-child{padding-left:1.1em!important;}
.witness tr.w td{background:#fff;border-top:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-bottom:1.5px solid var(--rule);}
.witness tr.w td:first-child{border-left:2px solid var(--base);border-radius:10px 0 0 10px;}
.witness tr.w td:last-child{border-right:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;}
.witness tr.j td{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;}
.witness tr.j td:first-child{border-radius:10px 0 0 10px;} .witness tr.j td:last-child{border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;}
.witness tr.j .kick{color:var(--light);}
.witness tr.o td{background:var(--tint);}
.witness tr.o td:first-child{border-radius:10px 0 0 10px;border-left:4px solid var(--base);} .witness tr.o td:last-child{border-radius:0 10px 10px 0;}
.witness .kick{margin:0;}
.hl{background:#FCE9C8;border-radius:3px;padding:0 0.15em;color:var(--ink);}
.hl.good{background:#D7F0E3;}

/* models */
.models .node{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.models .hf{font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;font-size:0.8em;color:var(--base);margin:0.1em 0 0.4em;}
.models .node{padding:0.7em 1em;}
.models .ty{margin-top:0.2em;color:var(--grey);font-size:0.9em;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:0.45em;}

/* QA sandwich */
.sand{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1.15fr 1fr;gap:0;margin-top:0.4em;}
.sand .band{padding:0.75em 1em;font:700 0.95em Montserrat,sans-serif;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6em;}
.sand .c1 .band{background:var(--tint);color:var(--dark);border-radius:12px 0 0 12px;border:1.5px solid var(--light);border-right:none;}
.sand .c2 .band{background:var(--dark);color:#fff;}
.sand .c3 .band{background:var(--tint);color:var(--dark);border-radius:0 12px 12px 0;border:1.5px solid var(--light);border-left:none;}
.sand .band .dot{width:1.9em;height:1.9em;font-size:0.8em;}
.sand .c2 .band .dot{border-color:#fff;color:var(--dark);}
.sand .body{padding:0.8em 1em 0;}
.sand .body .ttl{font-size:1em;}
.sand .lab{font:700 0.7em Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--grey);text-transform:uppercase;padding:0 1em;margin-top:0.5em;display:block;}

/* excel mock */
.xl{border:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:var(--shadow);font-size:0.92em;}
.xl .bar0{background:#F3F3F3;padding:0.35em 0.8em;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);font-family:monospace;font-size:0.9em;color:#444;}
.xl .bar0 i{width:0.7em;height:0.7em;border-radius:50%;background:#ddd;display:inline-block;}
.xl table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;margin:0!important;font-size:1em!important;}
.xl th{background:#FAFAFA;color:var(--grey);font-weight:700;text-align:left;padding:0.35em 0.7em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)!important;font-size:0.9em;}
.xl td{padding:0.33em 0.7em;border-bottom:1px solid #F0F0F0!important;}
.xl td.mono{font-size:0.9em;color:#444;}
.flag{display:inline-block;border-radius:5px;padding:0.05em 0.5em;font-weight:700;font-size:0.85em;color:#fff;}
.f-ex{background:#1E8F5B;} .f-gd{background:#3DA174;} .f-fr{background:#A6640C;} .f-po{background:#C8702A;} .f-bd{background:#C0392B;} .f-cl{background:#6A3D9A;}
.score{display:inline-block;width:2.2em;text-align:right;font-weight:700;}
.term{background:#221522;color:#EADFEA;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(83,1,83,.18);}
.term .tb{background:#3A243A;padding:0.4em 0.8em;display:flex;gap:0.4em;align-items:center;}
.term .tb i{width:0.7em;height:0.7em;border-radius:50%;display:inline-block;}
.term .tb span{margin-left:0.6em;font:0.85em monospace;color:#bfa8bf;}
.term pre{margin:0!important;background:transparent!important;border:none!important;box-shadow:none!important;width:100%!important;}
.term pre{font-size:1em!important;}
.term code{color:#EADFEA!important;font-size:0.82em!important;line-height:1.5!important;background:transparent!important;padding:0.8em 1em!important;display:block;white-space:pre;}
.term .c{color:#B98FB9;} .term .p{color:#E6A8E6;font-weight:700;}
.uses{margin-top:0.8em;}
.uses .u{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.7em;margin:0.45em 0;}
.uses .icon{color:var(--base);width:1.6em;height:1.6em;}

/* guards */
.guards .node{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0.75em 0.95em;}
.xf{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;gap:0.5em;margin-top:auto;background:#FBF8FB;border-radius:8px;padding:0.5em 0.6em;font-size:0.92em;}
.xf .in{color:#444;} .xf .ar{color:var(--light);font-weight:700;}
.xf .out{font-weight:700;color:var(--dark);}
.xf code{font-size:0.95em;}

/* worklist dots */
.wl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1fr;gap:1.2em;align-items:start;}
.dots{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(24,1fr);gap:5px;}
.dots i{display:block;aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:#E8E3E8;}
.dots i.f{background:var(--base);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff,0 0 0 3.5px var(--base);}
.trig .t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0.6em;margin:0.45em 0;}
.files{margin-top:0.8em;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-top:0.5em;}
.files .f{display:grid;grid-template-columns:11em 1fr;gap:0.6em;margin:0.25em 0;font-size:0.9em;}
.files code{color:var(--base);}

/* decisions */
.dec{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:0.6em 0.9em;}
.dec .d{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:0.7em;align-items:start;padding:0.55em 0.8em;border:1.5px solid var(--rule);border-radius:10px;background:#fff;}
.dec .d .ttl{font-size:0.98em;margin-bottom:0.15em;}
.dec .d p{margin:0;color:#3a3a3a;}
.dec .d.wide{grid-column:1 / -1;background:var(--tint);border-color:var(--light);}

/* stats */
.stats{display:flex;gap:0.8em;margin:0.7em 0 0;}
.stat{flex:1;border-left:4px solid var(--base);padding:0.2em 0.7em;}
.stat .n{display:block;font:700 1.35em Montserrat,sans-serif;color:var(--dark);line-height:1.1;}
.stat .l{display:block;font-size:0.6em;color:var(--grey);line-height:1.3;}

/* agent prompt */
.agent{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.45fr 1fr;gap:1.1em;align-items:start;}
.bubble{background:var(--tint);border-radius:16px 16px 16px 4px;padding:0.8em 1em;border:1.5px solid var(--light);font-family:"SFMono-Regular",Consolas,monospace;font-size:0.78em;line-height:1.5;color:#2a2a2a;white-space:pre-wrap;}
.who{font:700 0.75em Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;color:var(--grey);margin-bottom:0.4em;display:block;}
.ann .a{display:flex;gap:0.6em;align-items:flex-start;margin:0 0 0.65em;}
.ann .a .dot{width:1.7em;height:1.7em;font-size:0.75em;}

/* roadmap */
.road{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr auto 1fr auto 1fr auto 1fr;align-items:stretch;gap:0.4em;margin-top:0.6em;}
.road .node{display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
.road .node p{margin:0.2em 0;}
.status{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:0.5em;background:#E6F4EC;color:#14653F;border-radius:999px;padding:0.25em 0.9em;font-weight:700;font-size:0.95em;}

/* takeaways */
.tk{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0.5em;}
.tk .r{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:0.9em;align-items:center;padding:0.55em 0.9em;border-radius:10px;border:1.5px solid var(--rule);background:#fff;}
.tk .r:nth-child(odd){background:#FCF9FC;}
.tk .r .ttl{display:inline;font-size:1.02em;}
.tk .r span.x{color:#3a3a3a;}

/* results (kept) */
.bar{display:flex;height:2.1em;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;margin:0.6em 0 0.4em;font-size:0.7em;font-weight:700;color:#fff;}
.bar div{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
.bar .s1{background:var(--dark);} .bar .s2{background:var(--light);} .bar .s3{background:var(--bad);}
.barkey{font-size:0.62em;line-height:1.45;}
.barkey p{margin:0.25em 0;}
.barkey i{display:inline-block;width:0.8em;height:0.8em;border-radius:2px;margin-right:0.4em;vertical-align:-0.05em;}
/* pipeline svg */
.reveal svg.pipe{width:100%;height:auto;margin-top:0.2em;font-family:"Lato",sans-serif;overflow:visible;}
.pipe .rail line{stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:2;}
.pipe .rail circle{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--base);stroke-width:2;}
.pipe .rail text{fill:var(--base);font:700 13px Montserrat,sans-serif;text-anchor:middle;}
.pipe .steplab text{fill:var(--grey);font:700 11.5px Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;text-anchor:middle;}
.pipe .link path{fill:none;stroke:var(--light);stroke-width:2;}
.pipe .link path.strong{stroke:var(--dark);}
.pipe .link path.reject{stroke-dasharray:4 4;}
.pipe .n{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--rule);stroke-width:1.5;}
.pipe .n.qa,.pipe .lg .qa{fill:var(--tint);stroke:var(--light);stroke-width:1.5;}
.pipe .n.ai,.pipe .lg .ai{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--base);stroke-width:2;}
.pipe .n.out{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--dark);stroke-width:2.5;}
.pipe .hero{fill:var(--dark);}
.pipe .rej{fill:#fff;stroke:var(--light);stroke-dasharray:4 4;}
.pipe .rejt{fill:var(--grey);}
.pipe .wave{fill:none;stroke:var(--base);stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round;}
.pipe .t{fill:var(--dark);font:700 15px Montserrat,sans-serif;}
.pipe .t.big{font-size:17px;}
.pipe .s{fill:#3a3a3a;font-size:13px;}
.pipe .s.mono{font-family:monospace;font-size:12px;fill:var(--base);}
.pipe .k{fill:var(--base);font:700 10.5px Montserrat,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.12em;}
.pipe .inv,.pipe .inv text{fill:#fff;}
.pipe .k.inv{fill:var(--light);}
.pipe .brk{fill:none;stroke:var(--light);stroke-width:1.5;}
.pipe .brkt{fill:var(--grey);font-style:italic;}
.pipe .lg text{fill:var(--grey);font-size:12px;}

/* results bar */
.hatch{background:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,#E8CDE8 0 7px,#CFA0CF 7px 12px)!important;}
.bar .s2{color:var(--dark);}
.bar .hatch{text-shadow:0 0 4px #fff,0 0 4px #fff;}
.bar{gap:2px;}
.bar div{border-radius:2px;}
.bar .s1{background:var(--base);}
.barbrace{font-size:0.58em;color:var(--grey);margin:-0.1em 0 0.6em;}
.barbrace span{display:block;border-top:2px solid var(--light);padding-top:0.2em;text-align:center;}
.barkey i.hatch{display:inline-block;}

</style>
```

::: {.lede}
Turn hard field audio into transcripts you can **trust and audit**: AI does the heavy lifting, people check only what matters.
:::

```{=html}
<div class="v lg obj g4">
  <div class="node plain"><div class="head"><span class="dot fill">1</span><span class="ttl">Diagnose</span></div>
    <div>Why one ASR model, or one "clean this up" prompt, fails on field audio</div></div>
  <div class="node plain"><div class="head"><span class="dot fill">2</span><span class="ttl">Design</span></div>
    <div>A pipeline where <b>independent AI outputs check each other</b></div></div>
  <div class="node qa"><div class="head"><span class="dot">3</span><span class="ttl">Assure</span></div>
    <div>Quality checks <b>before, during and after</b> transcription</div></div>
  <div class="node qa"><div class="head"><span class="dot">4</span><span class="ttl">Target</span></div>
    <div>Send reviewers to the <b>few segments</b> that need a human</div></div>
</div>
<div class="v cap" style="font-size:0.5em">Case study: coastal-Bangladesh climate-survey interviews. The ideas transfer to any language and any recorded survey.</div>
```

# The problem {background-color="#530153"}

## The setting: survey interviews from coastal Bangladesh

**Goal:** clean, searchable Bengali transcripts with a faithful English translation.

```{=html}
<div class="v setting">
  <div>
    <div class="node plain ch">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="2,12 5,12 7,6 9,18 11,9 13,15 15,11 17,13 19,12 22,12"/></svg>
      <div><span class="ttl">Hard audio</span>Field recordings at 8 kHz, ~12 kbps: telephony-grade, heavily compressed</div></div>
    <div class="node plain ch">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M4 5h16v10H9l-5 4z"/><path d="M8 9h8M8 12h5"/></svg>
      <div><span class="ttl">Colloquial, regional Bengali</span>Dialect forms, fast speech, English banking and survey terms mixed in</div></div>
    <div class="node plain ch">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect x="5" y="11" width="14" height="9" rx="2"/><path d="M8 11V8a4 4 0 0 1 8 0v3"/></svg>
      <div><span class="ttl">Sensitive data</span>Interviews with vulnerable households cannot leave the machine</div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="node hero">
    <span class="kick">Hard constraint</span>
    <span class="big">8 GB</span>
    <span style="font-size:1.05em;margin-top:0.3em">one laptop GPU runs everything</span>
    <ul><li>No cloud</li><li>No API calls</li><li>No closed models</li></ul>
  </div>
</div>
```

## The one rule: never invent data

```{=html}
<div class="v">
<div class="fails">
  <div class="node plain fail">
    <div class="side"><span class="lab">AUDIO SAYS</span><span class="num">250</span><span class="lab">in the recording</span></div>
    <div class="arrowcol">→</div>
    <div class="side"><span class="lab">MODEL WRITES</span><span class="num x">2.5</span><span class="lab bad">plausible, wrong</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="node plain fail">
    <div class="side"><span class="lab">AUDIO SAYS</span><span class="num">6</span><span class="lab">household members</span></div>
    <div class="arrowcol">→</div>
    <div class="side"><span class="lab">MODEL WRITES</span><span class="num x">60</span><span class="lab bad">nobody notices</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="rules3">
  <div class="node"><span class="ttl">Numbers come from the audio</span>Never from the model's sense of what is likely</div>
  <div class="node"><span class="ttl">Fluent-but-wrong is worst</span>A clean sentence with a wrong fact is never questioned</div>
  <div class="node"><span class="ttl">Unsure? Say so</span>An honest <code>[unclear]</code> beats a confident guess</div>
</div>
<div class="cap">Illustrative values.</div>
</div>
```

## What does not work

```{=html}
<div class="v nowork g3">
  <div class="node">
    <span class="kick" style="color:var(--bad)">Failure 1</span><span class="ttl">One ASR engine</span>
    <div class="viz"><svg viewBox="0 0 220 60" style="width:88%"><rect x="2" y="16" width="56" height="28" rx="6" fill="#fff" stroke="#800280" stroke-width="2"/><text x="30" y="35" text-anchor="middle" style="font:700 12px Montserrat;fill:#530153">ASR</text><path d="M60,30 H84" stroke="#B974B9" stroke-width="2"/><path d="M88,30 h118" stroke="#CCC" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/><path d="M110,30 h14 M150,30 h10 M182,30 h14" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></div>
    <div>Too many errors on compressed, dialectal audio, and <b>no signal about where</b> it went wrong.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="node">
    <span class="kick" style="color:var(--bad)">Failure 2</span><span class="ttl">One "clean this up" prompt</span>
    <div class="viz"><div class="minibars">
      <div class="r"><span>Naive rewrite</span><span class="b" style="width:100%;background:var(--bad)"></span><b>53%</b></div>
      <div class="r"><span>Constrained</span><span class="b" style="width:9.4%;background:var(--base)"></span><b>5%</b></div>
      <div style="font-size:0.75em;color:var(--grey);text-align:center">character error rate</div>
    </div></div>
    <div>The LLM <b>rewrites text that was already correct</b>.</div>
  </div>
  <div class="node">
    <span class="kick" style="color:var(--bad)">Failure 3</span><span class="ttl">Dedicated translation model</span>
    <div class="viz"><div class="numfix">6 → <span class="x">696</span><br>250 → <span class="x">35</span></div></div>
    <div>IndicTrans2 <b>corrupted numbers</b> on our interviews.</div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="v banner light"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 8v5M12 16v.5"/></svg>
  <div><b>Lesson:</b> trust no single model. Give the AI <b>evidence</b>, <b>rules</b>, and a way to <b>abstain</b>.</div></div>
```

## Two witnesses, two failure modes

```{=html}
<div class="v wit">
  <div class="node">
    <span class="kick">Witness 1 · Sound</span><span class="ttl">titu · phonetic CTC</span>
    <div class="muted">Transcribes sound token by token, with little language-model bias</div>
    <div class="row"><b class="ok">+</b><span>Faithful to the <b>sound</b> of names, numbers, dialect words</span></div>
    <div class="row"><b class="bad">−</b><span>Can run words together or look garbled</span></div>
  </div>
  <div class="plus">+</div>
  <div class="node">
    <span class="kick">Witness 2 · Structure</span><span class="ttl">Whisper · regional fine-tune</span>
    <div class="muted">Seq2seq decoder with a strong internal language model</div>
    <div class="row"><b class="ok">+</b><span>Fluent, well-formed <b>sentences</b></span></div>
    <div class="row"><b class="bad">−</b><span>Swaps in a plausible wrong word: <span class="bn">বন্যা</span> "flood" → <span class="bn">বোন না</span> "sister-no"</span></div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="v merge"><svg viewBox="0 0 400 40" preserveAspectRatio="none"><path d="M40,0 C40,25 200,15 200,40 M360,0 C360,25 200,15 200,40"/></svg></div>
<div class="v banner"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="9" cy="12" r="6"/><circle cx="15" cy="12" r="6"/></svg>
  <div><b>Their errors are largely independent.</b> Where one fails, the other often holds: titu anchors the sound, Whisper anchors the structure.</div></div>
```

## The LLM judge in action

```{=html}
<table class="witness">
<tr class="w"><td><span class="kick">Witness 1 · sound</span></td><td><span class="bn"><span class="hl good">খানায়</span> ছয়জন সদস্য আছে আমরার ঘরে থাকে সবাই</span></td></tr>
<tr class="w"><td><span class="kick">Witness 2 · fluent</span></td><td><span class="bn"><span class="hl">থানায়</span> ছয় জন সদস্য আছে। সবাই আমাদের ঘরে থাকে।</span> <span class="muted">(+2 more readings)</span></td></tr>
<tr class="j"><td><span class="kick">Judge reasoning</span></td><td>"Household" (<span class="bn">খানা</span>) fits a household roster, "police station" (<span class="bn">থানা</span>) does not → take titu's word, keep Whisper's structure. The number <b>6</b> agrees in both → copy it exactly.</td></tr>
<tr class="o"><td><span class="kick">Output [bn]</span></td><td><span class="bn">খানায় ছয়জন সদস্য আছে। সবাই আমরার ঘরে থাকে।</span></td></tr>
<tr class="o"><td><span class="kick">Output [en]</span></td><td>There are six members in the household. They all live in our house.</td></tr>
</table>
<div class="cap">Illustrative example, invented, not real interview data. The full reasoning trace is saved per segment in <code>.reasoning.txt</code>.</div>
```

## Who is speaking? The LLM labels the roles

```{=html}
<svg class="dg" viewBox="0 0 1100 290" role="img" aria-label="A transcript segment that contains both a question and its answer goes to the LLM judge, which reads the content, splits it into turns and labels each turn ENUMERATOR or RESPONDENT.">
  <defs>
    <marker id="ra" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#B974B9"/></marker>
    <marker id="rad" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto"><path d="M0,0 L10,5 L0,10 z" fill="#530153"/></marker>
  </defs>
  <text class="k" x="10" y="16">1 · RECONCILED SEGMENT</text>
  <text class="k" x="432" y="16">2 · LLM READS THE CONTENT</text>
  <text class="k" x="736" y="16">3 · ROLE-LABELLED TURNS</text>

  <!-- segment -->
  <rect class="n ai" x="10" y="72" width="370" height="150" rx="12"/>
  <text class="k" x="28" y="98">ONE SEGMENT · NO SPEAKER INFO</text>
  <text x="28" y="134" style="font-family:'Noto Sans Bengali',sans-serif;font-size:17px;fill:#1A1A1A">আপনার পরিবারে কতজন সদস্য?</text>
  <text x="28" y="164" style="font-family:'Noto Sans Bengali',sans-serif;font-size:17px;fill:#1A1A1A">আমার পরিবারে ছয়জন।</text>
  <text class="s g" x="28" y="200">question and answer captured together</text>

  <path class="ln" d="M380,147 H428" marker-end="url(#ra)"/>

  <!-- LLM -->
  <rect class="hero" x="432" y="52" width="260" height="190" rx="14"/>
  <text class="k inv" x="452" y="80">LLM JUDGE · SAME CALL</text>
  <text class="t inv" x="452" y="108">Who asks? Who answers?</text>
  <text class="s inv" x="452" y="140">• asks survey questions, reads</text>
  <text class="s inv" x="462" y="160">the consent script → enumerator</text>
  <text class="s inv" x="452" y="186">• describes own life, family,</text>
  <text class="s inv" x="462" y="206">floods, money → respondent</text>
  <text class="s inv" x="452" y="230" style="font-weight:700">splits the segment into turns</text>

  <path class="ln d" d="M692,120 C712,120 712,92 732,92" marker-end="url(#rad)"/>
  <path class="ln d" d="M692,174 C712,174 712,202 732,202" marker-end="url(#rad)"/>

  <!-- turns -->
  <rect class="pill win" x="736" y="56" width="354" height="72" rx="14"/>
  <text class="t" x="756" y="84">ENUMERATOR</text>
  <text class="s" x="756" y="110">"How many members in your household?"</text>
  <rect class="pill win" x="736" y="166" width="354" height="72" rx="14"/>
  <text class="t" x="756" y="194">RESPONDENT</text>
  <text class="s" x="756" y="220">"Six, in my family."</text>
  <text class="s g" x="10" y="280" style="font-size:12px">Illustrative lines, invented.</text>
</svg>
<div class="v g3" style="font-size:0.6em;margin-top:0.3em">
  <div class="node plain"><span class="ttl">No separate diarization model</span>Voice clustering can only say <i>which voice</i>, never <i>which role</i>. The LLM works from <b>what is said</b>.</div>
  <div class="node qa"><span class="ttl">Auditable</span>The role decision and the turn split are written to the reasoning trace (<code>.reasoning.txt</code>) for every segment.</div>
  <div class="node plain"><span class="ttl">Why it matters</span>Analysts get answers separated from questions, and auditors can check <b>what the enumerator actually asked</b>.</div>
</div>
```

## The models: all open-source, all local

```{=html}
<div class="v models g3">
  <div class="node"><span class="kick">Witness 1 · sound</span><span class="ttl">titu FastConformer</span>
    <div class="hf">hishab/titu_stt_bn_fastconformer</div><div class="ty">NeMo FastConformer + CTC</div></div>
  <div class="node"><span class="kick">Witness 2 · structure</span><span class="ttl">Whisper-medium</span>
    <div class="hf">bengaliAI/tugstugi_bengaliai-regional-asr_whisper-medium</div><div class="ty">Regional Bengali fine-tune</div></div>
  <div class="node hero"><span class="kick">Judge</span><span class="ttl">Gemma-3-12B</span>
    <div class="hf" style="color:#E6C3E6">unsloth/gemma-3-12b-it-GGUF · Q4_K_XL</div><div class="ty" style="color:#D9BED9;border-color:#7a3a7a">Fusion, translation <b style="color:#fff">and role labels</b> · 4-bit</div></div>
</div>

  <div><b>Privacy by construction.</b> No audio, text or translation is sent to any external service.</div></div>
```

# Data quality assurance {background-color="#530153"}

## Good audio is the foundation

::: {.lede}
AI can fix the transcriber's mistakes, but it **cannot recover what the microphone never captured**.
:::

```{=html}
<svg class="dg" viewBox="0 0 1100 250" role="img" aria-label="Conceptual diagram: the recording sets a ceiling. With a poor recording, the ASR witnesses and the LLM judge stay low; with a good recording, the LLM judge can reach much higher. The judge recovers ASR errors only up to what the recording contains.">
  <text class="k" x="20" y="16" style="font-size:13px">POOR RECORDING</text>
  <text class="k" x="590" y="16" style="font-size:13px">GOOD RECORDING</text>
  <line x1="20" y1="210" x2="510" y2="210" stroke="#E2E2E2" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="20" y1="128" x2="510" y2="128" stroke="#C0392B" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="7 6"/>
  <text class="s" x="510" y="118" text-anchor="end" style="fill:#C0392B;font-weight:700">ceiling set by the audio</text>
  <rect x="40" y="128" width="110" height="82" rx="6" fill="#530153"/>
  <rect x="200" y="160" width="110" height="50" rx="6" fill="#B974B9"/>
  <rect x="360" y="131" width="110" height="79" rx="6" fill="#800280"/>
  <text class="s" x="95" y="234" text-anchor="middle">Recording</text>
  <text class="s" x="255" y="234" text-anchor="middle">ASR witnesses</text>
  <text class="s" x="415" y="234" text-anchor="middle">LLM judge</text>
  <line x1="590" y1="210" x2="1080" y2="210" stroke="#E2E2E2" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="590" y1="40" x2="1080" y2="40" stroke="#1E8F5B" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="7 6"/>
  <text class="s" x="1080" y="32" text-anchor="end" style="fill:#1E8F5B;font-weight:700">ceiling set by the audio</text>
  <rect x="610" y="40" width="110" height="170" rx="6" fill="#530153"/>
  <rect x="770" y="90" width="110" height="120" rx="6" fill="#B974B9"/>
  <rect x="930" y="45" width="110" height="165" rx="6" fill="#800280"/>
  <text class="s" x="665" y="234" text-anchor="middle">Recording</text>
  <text class="s" x="825" y="234" text-anchor="middle">ASR witnesses</text>

</svg>
<div class="cap" style="margin-top:0.2em">Conceptual: bar heights show the idea, not measured values. The judge can recover ASR errors, but only up to the ceiling.</div>
<div class="v banner"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="2,12 5,12 7,6 9,18 11,9 13,15 15,11 17,13 19,12 22,12"/></svg>
  <div>In our results, <b>about half of the rough segments trace back to the recording</b>. Better audio is the cheapest accuracy gain: no extra GPU, no bigger model.</div></div>
```

## Getting good audio in the field

```{=html}
<div class="v g3 field" style="font-size:0.72em">
  <div class="node plain"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><rect x="9" y="3" width="6" height="11" rx="3"/><path d="M5 11a7 7 0 0 0 14 0M12 18v3"/></svg>
    <span class="ttl">Mic close to the respondent</span><div>An external or clip-on mic beats the tablet's built-in one; keep it near the speaker's mouth.</div></div>
  <div class="node plain"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><path d="M3 12h3l3-7 4 14 3-7h5"/></svg>
    <span class="ttl">Set the gain, avoid clipping</span><div>Do a 10-second test before each interview; distorted peaks cannot be repaired later.</div></div>
  <div class="node plain"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><path d="M4 9v6h4l5 4V5L8 9z"/><path d="M17 9l4 6M21 9l-4 6"/></svg>
    <span class="ttl">Choose a quiet spot</span><div>Away from generators, traffic, crowds and wind; use a foam cover outdoors.</div></div>
  <div class="node plain"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><rect x="4" y="4" width="16" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M8 9h8M8 13h8M8 17h5"/></svg>
    <span class="ttl">Keep the original file</span><div>Record at 16 kHz or more and never re-compress: our audio arrived as 8 kHz, ~12 kbps.</div></div>
  <div class="node plain"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><circle cx="8" cy="12" r="4"/><circle cx="16" cy="12" r="4"/></svg>
    <span class="ttl">Compare mics before fieldwork</span><div>Pilot two or three mics on the same interviews; <code>test-mics</code> ranks them.</div></div>
  <div class="node qa"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" style="color:var(--base)"><rect x="4" y="5" width="16" height="15" rx="2"/><path d="M4 10h16M9 3v4M15 3v4M8 15l2 2 4-4"/></svg>
    <span class="ttl">Check every day's uploads</span><div>Run the quality report daily and give enumerators feedback while they are still in the field.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="v" style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0.8em;margin-top:0.8em">
<div class="term sm"><div class="tb"><i style="background:#E06C75"></i><i style="background:#E5C07B"></i><i style="background:#98C379"></i><span>before fieldwork</span></div>
<pre><code><span class="p">$</span> uv run asr-pipeline test-mics ./pilot -l ben</code></pre></div>
<div class="term sm"><div class="tb"><i style="background:#E06C75"></i><i style="background:#E5C07B"></i><i style="background:#98C379"></i><span>every day</span></div>
<pre><code><span class="p">$</span> just quality ./uploads/today</code></pre></div>
</div>
```

## QA happens at three points

```{=html}
<div class="v lg sand">
  <div class="c1"><div class="band"><span class="dot">B</span>Before</div>
    <div class="body"><span class="ttl">Audio quality report</span>Score every recording; catch broken ones before spending GPU time on them.</div></div>
  <div class="c2"><div class="band"><span class="dot">D</span>During · the only generative step</div>
    <div class="body"><span class="ttl">Constrained generation</span>Temperature 0 and explicit rules: keep numbers exact, translate meaning, code-switch only on genuine English.</div></div>
  <div class="c3"><div class="band"><span class="dot">A</span>After</div>
    <div class="body"><span class="ttl">Guards + review worklist</span>Rules decide what ships and exactly which segments a human checks.</div></div>
</div>
<div class="v lg sand" style="margin-top:0.2em">
  <span class="lab">rules · no AI</span><span class="lab" style="text-align:center">AI, tightly constrained</span><span class="lab" style="text-align:right">rules · no AI</span>
</div>
<div class="v banner light" style="margin-top:1.1em"><div>The AI produces the transcript. <b>Plain, auditable rules</b> decide whether to trust it.</div></div>
```

## After: guards that refuse to fabricate

```{=html}
<div class="v guards g2" style="font-size:0.76em">
  <div class="node qa"><span class="kick">Guard 1</span><span class="ttl">Number-abstain</span>
    <p>A digit <b>neither witness heard</b> is blanked. Fabricated numbers never ship.</p>
    <div class="xf"><span class="in">witnesses: <b>six</b><br>model: <b>60</b></span><span class="ar">→</span><span class="out"><code>[unclear]</code> + flag</span></div></div>
  <div class="node qa"><span class="kick">Guard 2</span><span class="ttl">Foreign-script abstain</span>
    <p>Characters outside Bengali + Latin (a stray Cyrillic or Devanagari word) are blanked.</p>
    <div class="xf"><span class="in">«хозяйства»</span><span class="ar">→</span><span class="out"><code>[unclear]</code> + flag</span></div></div>
  <div class="node qa"><span class="kick">Guard 3</span><span class="ttl">Witness disagreement</span>
    <p>Output that drifts far from <b>both</b> witnesses goes to a human.</p>
    <div class="xf"><span class="in">far from titu<br>far from Whisper</span><span class="ar">→</span><span class="out">⚑ review</span></div></div>
  <div class="node qa"><span class="kick">Guard 4</span><span class="ttl">Greedy decoding</span>
    <p>On near-empty segments, sampling <b>invented</b> plausible survey answers.</p>
    <div class="xf"><span class="in">temperature 0.7<br><span class="bad">invents a turn</span></span><span class="ar">→</span><span class="out">temperature 0<br><span class="ok">stays grounded</span></span></div></div>
</div>
```

## The review worklist: humans check only what matters

```{=html}
<div class="v wl" style="font-size:0.74em">
  <div>
    <span class="kick">One interview · 216 segments</span>
    <div class="dots" id="wldots"></div>
    <div class="cap">Illustrative. Purple dots are flagged segments; grey ones need no listening.</div>
  </div>
  <div>
    <span class="ttl">A segment is flagged if it…</span>
    <div class="trig">
      <div class="t"><span class="dot">#</span><span>contains <b>any number</b></span></div>
      <div class="t"><span class="dot">≠</span><span>has the two witnesses <b>disagreeing</b></span></div>
      <div class="t"><span class="dot">?</span><span>contains text marked <b>[unclear]</b></span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="files">
      <div class="f"><code>name.txt</code><span>Final transcript with roles</span></div>
      <div class="f"><code>name.review.txt</code><span><b>QA worklist</b> with reasons</span></div>
      <div class="f"><code>name.reasoning.txt</code><span>Judge's reasoning + witnesses</span></div>
      <div class="f"><code>name.raw.txt</code><span>Pre-LLM transcript, for audit</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="v banner light"><div>The audio ceiling cannot be removed locally. Instead of hiding it, the pipeline <b>shows exactly what to double-check</b>.</div></div>
<script>
(function(){var d=document.getElementById('wldots');if(!d||d.childElementCount)return;
var f=[7,19,33,41,58,66,90,104,117,131,150,163,171,188,202,209];
for(var i=0;i<216;i++){var e=document.createElement('i');if(f.indexOf(i)>-1)e.className='f';d.appendChild(e);}})();
</script>
```

# Results {background-color="#530153"}

## How usable are the transcripts?

Coherence of the English output, 50 segments rated:

::: {.bar}
<div class="s1" style="width:56%">56% coherent</div><div class="s2 hatch" style="width:21%">≈21% audio-limited</div><div class="s2" style="width:21%">≈21% other</div><div class="s3" style="width:2%"></div>
:::
::: {.barbrace}
<span style="margin-left:56%;width:42%">42% partial: gist clear, rough spans</span>
:::

::: {.barkey}
<p><i style="background:var(--base)"></i>**Fully coherent (28/50)**: clean prose, e.g. "so many people's conditions worsen during floods"</p>
<p><i class="hatch"></i>**Partial, audio-limited (≈ half of the 21)**: the recording is too degraded; no model can recover what was never captured</p>
<p><i style="background:var(--light)"></i>**Partial, other**: a mistranslation, a transliteration, or an [unclear] on fair audio</p>
<p><i style="background:var(--bad)"></i>**Garbled (1/50)**: largely incoherent</p>
:::

::: {.callout-note-custom}
**≈ 98% usable for qualitative analysis.** Half of the rough segments are a **recording problem, not a model problem**: better field audio is the cheapest accuracy gain, which is why QA starts *before* transcription.
:::

## Key design decisions

```{=html}
<div class="v dec" style="font-size:0.76em">
  <div class="d"><span class="dot fill">1</span><div><span class="ttl">Two independent witnesses</span><p>Sound vs structure: their errors cancel</p></div></div>
  <div class="d"><span class="dot fill">2</span><div><span class="ttl">N-best fusion</span><p>Several readings let the judge choose from context</p></div></div>
  <div class="d"><span class="dot fill">3</span><div><span class="ttl">An LLM judge, not a vote</span><p>Reconciles and translates with context</p></div></div>
  <div class="d"><span class="dot fill">4</span><div><span class="ttl">Constrained prompt, temperature 0</span><p>Keeps numbers exact; no invented answers</p></div></div>
  <div class="d"><span class="dot">5</span><div><span class="ttl">Deterministic guards</span><p>The model never has the last word on a number</p></div></div>
  <div class="d"><span class="dot fill">6</span><div><span class="ttl">The LLM labels the roles</span><p>Enumerator vs respondent from what each speaker says, not voice</p></div></div>
  <div class="d wide"><span class="dot">7</span><div><span class="ttl">Sequential model loading</span><p>Load → use → unload: the whole stack fits on one 8 GB laptop GPU</p></div></div>
</div>
```

# Use it yourself {background-color="#530153"}

## Running the pipeline

```{=html}
<div class="v">
<div class="term"><div class="tb"><i style="background:#E06C75"></i><i style="background:#E5C07B"></i><i style="background:#98C379"></i><span>asr-pipeline</span></div>
<pre><code><span class="c"># 1 · check audio quality first (no GPU needed)</span>
<span class="p">$</span> just quality ./interviews

<span class="c"># 2 · transcribe one interview (Bengali two-witness fusion)</span>
<span class="p">$</span> just fusion interview.m4a -o ./outputs

<span class="c"># 3 · a whole Survey Solutions folder (resume-safe)</span>
<span class="p">$</span> just fusion-folder ./interviews

<span class="c"># other languages: general multilingual path (e.g. Swahili)</span>
<span class="p">$</span> uv run asr-pipeline transcribe interview.m4a -l swa</code></pre></div>
<div class="stats">
  <div class="stat"><span class="n">8 GB</span><span class="l">GPU is enough for the Bengali stack</span></div>

  <div class="stat"><span class="n">1,600+</span><span class="l">languages via the general multilingual path</span></div>
</div>
</div>
```

## Adapting it with your coding agent

```{=html}
<div class="v agent">
  <div><span class="who">YOU → CODING AGENT</span>
<div class="bubble">Clone github.com/noureini/asr-pipeline and read the README.

1. Run the audio quality report on ./my_interviews and summarise how many files are POOR, BAD or CLIPPED, with file names.

2. Find a phonetic (CTC) and a fluent (Whisper) model on Hugging Face for &lt;my language&gt;; list candidates.

3. Propose a config based on fusion_production.yaml. Do not change the number-abstain guard.

Ask before downloading any model larger than 2 GB.</div></div>
  <div class="ann"><span class="who">WHY IT WORKS</span>
    <div class="a"><span class="dot fill">1</span><div><b>Context first</b>: the README is the agent's memory file</div></div>
    <div class="a"><span class="dot fill">2</span><div><b>Bounded tasks</b> with a concrete output</div></div>
    <div class="a"><span class="dot">3</span><div><b>A fixed rule</b>: keep the guards, change the witnesses</div></div>
    <div class="a"><span class="dot fill">4</span><div><b>A stop rule</b> before anything expensive</div></div>
    <div class="node qa" style="margin-top:0.8em;padding:0.6em 0.8em">Validate on <b>20–30 segments</b> with a native speaker before scaling.</div>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Key takeaways

```{=html}
<div class="v tk" style="font-size:0.86em">
  <div class="r"><span class="dot fill">1</span><div><span class="ttl">Never trust a single model on hard audio.</span> <span class="x">Use independent "witnesses" whose errors differ.</span></div></div>
  <div class="r"><span class="dot fill">2</span><div><span class="ttl">Give the LLM evidence, not freedom.</span> <span class="x">Several hypotheses, tight rules, temperature 0.</span></div></div>
  <div class="r"><span class="dot">3</span><div><span class="ttl">Let rules, not AI, decide what ships.</span> <span class="x">Numbers no witness heard are blanked, never guessed.</span></div></div>
  <div class="r"><span class="dot">4</span><div><span class="ttl">Good audio is the foundation.</span> <span class="x">Half the rough output is a recording problem: fix it in the field, check it daily.</span></div></div>
  <div class="r"><span class="dot">5</span><div><span class="ttl">Point humans to the few segments that matter.</span> <span class="x">The worklist makes review targeted and auditable.</span></div></div>
</div>
```
